VR.title: Apple Publishes Detailed Technical Specifications for Third-party Vision Pro Motion Controllers
VR.summary: Apple has published technical specifications for third-party motion controllers compatible with its Vision Pro headset, enhancing developer opportunities for the platform.

VR.title: Xreal's new $299 AR glasses bring the big-screen experience to more people
VR.summary: Xreal's new a01+ AR glasses launch in the U.S. for $299, offering a lightweight design and an immersive 147-inch virtual screen experience.

VR.title: Steam Frame Launch Nears as Valve Releases ‘Great on Frame’ Store Page
VR.summary: Valve has released a new store page for its upcoming Steam Frame headset, indicating a potential launch is imminent.

VR.title: ‘Ghosts of Tabor’ Returns to Its Roots in 2024-era ‘Legacy’ Edition This Month
VR.summary: Combat Waffle is set to release Ghosts of Tabor: LEGACY, returning the game to its 2024 roots for Meta Quest and PC VR.

VR.title: Meta Reaffirms "Multiple Next-Generation Headsets", Hints At Connect Announcement
VR.summary: Meta's CTO confirmed the company is developing multiple next-generation headsets, hinting at an announcement during the upcoming Connect event.

VR.title: ‘Tomb Raider’ VR Reportedly Cancelled According to Leaked Images & Video
VR.summary: Leaked images reveal that Vertigo Games was working on a Tomb Raider VR game before the project was cancelled earlier this year.

AI.title: Apple sues OpenAI for allegedly stealing hardware secrets
AI.summary: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging the AI startup stole confidential hardware secrets from its employees.

AI.title: Waze is getting a bunch of new AI-powered features
AI.summary: Waze is integrating Google's AI assistant, Gemini, to enhance user experience with new personalized features in its driving app.

AI.title: Meta turns off the Instagram feature that let users make AI deepfakes of public accounts
AI.summary: Meta has disabled an Instagram feature that allowed users to create AI deepfakes of public accounts following significant backlash.

AI.title: Apple’s failed self-driving car program left a legacy of powerful AI chips
AI.summary: Apple's failed self-driving car initiative contributed to the development of powerful AI chips that enhance its current hardware capabilities.

AI.title: Now, defenders are embracing the prompt injection, too
AI.summary: Defenders are now adopting prompt injection techniques to counteract AI hacking attempts, showcasing an evolving cybersecurity landscape.

AI.title: Microsoft’s carbon emissions went up 25 percent last year
AI.summary: Microsoft's carbon emissions rose by 25% last year, raising concerns about the company's ability to meet its sustainability goals.

NFL.title: Niners part owner agrees to purchase Seahawks
NFL.summary: Niners limited partner Vinod Khosla has agreed to purchase the Seahawks for a record $9.612 billion, requiring divestment from the 49ers.

NFL.title: Commanders to retire No. 44 of HOF RB Riggins
NFL.summary: The Washington Commanders will retire Hall of Famer John Riggins' No. 44 jersey, honoring his legacy over 40 years after his iconic Super Bowl run.

NFL.title: Sources: CB Douglas to sign with Commanders
NFL.summary: Free agent cornerback Rasul Douglas is set to sign a one-year deal with the Washington Commanders worth up to $3.8 million.

NFL.title: Study: NFLers die from dementia at higher rate
NFL.summary: A new study reveals NFL players are four times more likely to die from neurodegenerative diseases like dementia compared to the general population.

NFL.title: ESPN re-signs Adam Schefter to "multi-year agreement"
NFL.summary: ESPN has re-signed reporter Adam Schefter to a multi-year agreement, ensuring his continued presence in NFL coverage.

NFL.title: Clutch Vinatieri to enter Colts' Ring of Honor
NFL.summary: Kicker Adam Vinatieri, soon to be inducted into the Hall of Fame, will also enter the Colts' Ring of Honor on October 18.
